eyebrow: Section 1 — what am I looking at
code:
SELECT
    SERVERPROPERTY('MachineName')    AS machine_name,
    SERVERPROPERTY('Edition')        AS edition,
    SERVERPROPERTY('ProductVersion') AS product_version,
    si.sqlserver_start_time,
    DATEDIFF(HOUR, si.sqlserver_start_time, GETDATE())
        AS hours_since_restart
FROM sys.dm_os_sys_info AS si;
caption: A fresh restart resets wait stats and the plan cache — check this first.

code:
SELECT TOP (10)
    wait_type, wait_time_ms, waiting_tasks_count,
    wait_time_ms * 1.0 / NULLIF(waiting_tasks_count, 0)
        AS avg_wait_ms
FROM sys.dm_os_wait_stats
WHERE wait_type NOT IN (
    'SLEEP_TASK', 'LAZYWRITER_SLEEP', 'CHECKPOINT_QUEUE', /* ... */
)
ORDER BY wait_time_ms DESC;
caption: Same query from Lesson 8, now living beside the identity check that qualifies it.

code:
-- Run inside the target database (USE first)
SELECT
    name AS logical_name, type_desc,
    size / 128.0 AS size_mb,
    size / 128.0
      - CAST(FILEPROPERTY(name,'SpaceUsed') AS int) / 128.0
      AS free_mb,
    growth, is_percent_growth
FROM sys.database_files
ORDER BY type_desc;
caption: Space runs out quietly, then all at once — this catches it early.
